body.name: Two-copy lift
body.construction: For \(G\), each directed edge \(u\to v\), including \(u=v\), gives \(u_0\to v_0\), \(u_0\to v_1\), and \(u_1\to v_1\). Each unordered bidirected edge \(\{u,v\}\), including \(u=v\), gives \(u_p\leftrightarrow v_q\) for every \(p,q\in\{0,1\}\). Thus a bidirected loop \(\{u,u\}\) gives the three distinct unordered lifted edges \(\{u_0,u_0\}\), \(\{u_0,u_1\}\), and \(\{u_1,u_1\}\); the index choices \((0,1)\) and \((1,0)\) name the same cross-copy edge.
